review_description: BNV were very good, prompt, courteous and they cleaned up afterwards. It was great to deal with a local company who did such a good job.

My biggest concern was getting a local (ACT) installer and none of those suggested by SolarQuotes were locally based.I was prepared to, and eventually did, pay a little more for a local.  The quality of the system was directly comparable with out of town quotes.  The upgrade to my meter box added $800 to the total (something the out-of-towners did not quote on)  As it turned out, the first install did not pass inspection - because the standards had been amended 3 months previously and my installer was not up to date.  It would have been passed under the old standard.  This delayed having the system turned on for three weeks.
